title: Assistance personnelle — Grand Raid de La Réunion 2026
claims: Personal assistance is allowed only within 300 m before and 300 m after an official Grand Raid aid station, in zones marked by the station chief.
Accepting a pacer or any outside assistance outside those tolerance zones is penalised under article 17 of the rules.
The Diagonale des Fous has 15 authorised assistance points out of 33 points in total.

The authorised assistance points include the start, Domaine Vidot, Notre-Dame de la Paix, Nez de Bœuf, Mare à Boue, Hell-Bourg, Départ Sentier Scout, Grand Place les Bas, Roche Plate, Ti Col Maïdo, Ilet Savannah, La Possession, Grande Chaloupe, Colorado and the finish.
The assistance page states the 2026 Diagonale course as 180.8 km with a Thursday 15 October 22:00 start from Saint-Pierre to Saint-Denis.
The page cites the official 2026 cut-off tables as its source and says the official rules prevail in case of divergence.
